message.content: {"9517_8353800801467": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The radiographic findings of a right-sided, slightly lobulated mass in the superior mediastinum with increased retrotracheal soft-tissue density are characteristic of an oesophageal lipoma."}, "9517_8353800813914": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The combination of a lobulated superior mediastinal mass and retrotracheal density on lateral view strongly suggests an oesophageal lipoma rather than other mediastinal pathologies."}, "9517_8353800909542": {"answer": "B", "reason": "An oesophageal lipoma located in the posterior mediastinum typically causes posterior displacement of the trachea due to its mass effect from behind."}, "9517_8353801940827": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The lobulated appearance and location are consistent with an oesophageal lipoma, which clinically correlates with symptoms of dysphagia and dyspepsia due to esophageal compression."}}
